findings: proven: the MoltenVK compiler object leaked on every archive hit and strict miss (compile() never ran, so destroy() waited forever)
medium: the archive lookup ran outside upstream's device lock and compile timeout
low: two devices of one identity could write the same segment name
low: the session bounds could be overshot by concurrent creations
hardening: the archives were destroyed before the queues that may still compile
notJudgedWithoutADevice: archive hits for descriptor kinds the test set lacks (depth or stencil attachments, several color attachments, multisampling, tessellation, multiview)
whether an addition recompiles when Metal has evicted the binary it just compiled
the cost of saves and of the checksum pass on iOS storage
pipelines compiled again when their segment ages out (hits are not collected again)

why: a gain is measured only for pipeline state creation, and only with the system Metal cache removed: 62 graphics creations 0.95-1.01 s against 1.35-1.39 s (run 2), 1.34-1.51 s against 2.03-2.18 s (run 1), on the macOS runner; libraries remain; no gain measured for compute pipelines

with a warm system Metal cache no reproducible benefit is established (0.18 against 0.20 s in run 2, 0.20 against 0.21 s in run 1, one session of each kind per run); the measures do not prove a zero gain

historical iPhone journals (IPA 624-684): in play, of the library + pipeline creation time (SPIR-V to MSL conversion not counted), pipeline state creation is 16.5-18.9 % and library creation from MSL 81.1-83.5 % (ten sessions with 20 s or more); with the conversion counted: pipelines 16.0-18.0 %, libraries 76.4-80.8 %, conversion 2.9-6.2 %
new libraries in play track new SPIR-V conversions (pairs of module and conversion settings the pipeline cache did not hold); this does not prove the shaders were met for the first time

26 of the 35 historical launch reports have a warm system Metal cache (at most 2.1 s of libraries and 1.0 s of pipelines); the 9 others compile libraries for 13.5-65.8 s and pipelines for 2.4-12.6 s (14.7-18.3 %)
no measure on an iPhone exists for the prototype
decision.reopenWhen: an iPhone measure after a cold system Metal cache shows pipeline state creation worth removing, or the library stage has been dealt with first
decision.maintainer: closure validated on 2026-11-09: no MoltenVK integration, no IPA, no further macOS tests for this lot
